set.body:
Goal: ensure the portable parser has identical scientific meaning on both supported platforms.

Acceptance criteria:
- Shared fixtures run through the same pure parser and semantic materializer on JVM and Scala.js.
- Canonical manifests and SHA-256 digests agree exactly for every portable supported fixture.
- Text decoding, decimal parsing, negative zero, newline handling, long integer timestamps, and ordering receive dedicated parity fixtures.
- Any platform-specific FS2 source adapter is tested separately from shared parsing semantics.
- Generated parity artifacts are deterministic and checked in CI.
- A one-platform semantic mutant is demonstrated to fail the parity court.
set.title: Prove JVM and Scala.js EyeLink canonical-manifest parity
